statusNote: Potential responsibilities only. No role is legally held or accepted by EMBARCARTE until a written decision and the supporting contracts exist. A third-party module certificate is not certification of the integrated final product. Nothing here is a legal opinion.

roleDefinitions.label: Brand owner
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that owns or claims the MAREA brand and controls its public use.
potentialObligations: Accurate brand attribution in every channel
Licence/assignment of the mark to the selling entity
evidenceRequired: Trademark clearance search and counsel opinion
traceabilityDuties: Brand attribution consistent across product, packaging, manuals and web
marketSurveillanceDuties: Correct or withdraw misleading brand claims when discovered
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: None directly; the seller/manufacturer carries statutory remedies.
releaseRestrictions: MAREA_PUBLIC_USE = NO_GO until clearance; no ® or ™

roleDefinitions.label: Manufacturer
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that designs or manufactures the product, or has it designed/manufactured, and places it on the market under its name or trademark.
potentialObligations: Conformity assessment and EU declaration of conformity
GPSR safety duties and incident reporting
CRA secure development, vulnerability handling, support period and reporting
traceabilityDuties: Manufacturer name and address on product/packaging
Retention of technical documentation for the legal period
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: Legal guarantee and product-liability exposure; cannot be excluded by contract against consumers.
releaseRestrictions: No market placement before GATE-MARKET-PLACEMENT and GATE-CRA-CYBERSECURITY

roleDefinitions.label: OEM assembler / integrator
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that integrates third-party certified modules or single-board computers into a new product, possibly under its own brand.
potentialObligations: System-level conformity assessment of the integrated product
Verification that module certificates do not cover the final configuration
contractNeeded: Module supply agreement with conformity representations
traceabilityDuties: Link final serial to module batch
marketSurveillanceDuties: Act as manufacturer for the integrated product
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: As manufacturer of the integrated product, not merely as module reseller.
releaseRestrictions: A third-party module certificate alone never closes the gate

roleDefinitions.label: Importer
roleDefinitions.definition: EU entity that brings a product from a third country into the EU market.
potentialObligations: Verify the manufacturer's conformity assessment and marking
Ensure instructions and safety information are in the required language
Identify itself as importer on the product/packaging
Store and transport without affecting conformity
evidenceRequired: Importer name/address on product or packaging
traceabilityDuties: Importer identification and import lot records
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: Joint responsibility with the manufacturer for the imported product.
releaseRestrictions: No import/placement until the manufacturer evidence is verified

roleDefinitions.label: Distributor
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity in the supply chain that makes a product available without being the manufacturer or importer.
potentialObligations: Verify CE marking and traceability before making available
Not alter the product or its instructions
Cooperate with surveillance and corrective action
traceabilityDuties: Record supplier and customer lots where required
marketSurveillanceDuties: Stop supply and inform authority/manufacturer on non-conformity
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: As seller to its customer; recourse against supplier by contract.
releaseRestrictions: Cannot present uncertified product as certified

roleDefinitions.label: Seller / retailer
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that contracts with the customer, including distance selling.
potentialObligations: Total price, tax and delivery-cost disclosure
Legal guarantee and commercial warranty information
traceabilityDuties: Product serial at sale where applicable
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: Primary counterparty for consumer remedies and legal guarantee.
releaseRestrictions: No purchasable CTA without GATE-LEGAL-ENTITY and GATE-CONSUMER-TERMS

roleDefinitions.label: Installer / commissioning agent
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that installs, commissions or services the product on a vessel.
potentialObligations: Install per instructions and applicable electrical/marine practice
Warn about limitations and unsafe configurations
traceabilityDuties: Record vessel, serial and installation configuration
marketSurveillanceDuties: Report field failures and unsafe installations
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: Liable for installation defects; allocation defined in the installer agreement.
releaseRestrictions: No 'certified installer' claim until a certification scheme exists

roleDefinitions.label: SaaS provider
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that hosts and operates software and subscriptions (NAV cloud features, WATCH monitoring, FLEET, WEATHER).
potentialObligations: CRA cybersecurity duties for products with digital elements
evidenceRequired: CRA technical documentation and security tests
Measured availability if any SLA is stated
traceabilityDuties: Account, entitlement and device association records
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: Conformity remedies for digital services; liability per terms and mandatory law.
releaseRestrictions: No SLA, uptime, security or certification claim before evidence

roleDefinitions.label: Data controller
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data (account, billing, self-determined telemetry, marketing).
marketSurveillanceDuties: Respond to AEPD and data subjects
roleDefinitions.warrantyLiability: GDPR administrative fines and compensation claims.
releaseRestrictions: No data-protection claim before DPIA/DPA evidence

roleDefinitions.label: Data processor
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that processes personal data on behalf of a customer/controller (for example FLEET tenant data).
potentialObligations: Assist with data-subject rights and breach notification (Article 33(2))
marketSurveillanceDuties: Notify controller of breaches without undue delay
releaseRestrictions: No FLEET onboarding before the DPA exists

roleDefinitions.label: Service operator
roleDefinitions.definition: Entity that operates customer support, monitoring, RMA or field service.
evidenceRequired: Staffing evidence for any stated response time
marketSurveillanceDuties: Feed field failures into corrective action
releaseRestrictions: No '24/7', response-time or certified-support claim before staffing evidence

scenarios.title: Own-branded finished product
scenarios.description: EMBARCARTE designs or commissions the hardware, brands it MAREA and sells it directly.
scenarios.supplierModel: Contract manufacturer or design house; EMBARCARTE is legal manufacturer.
traceabilityDuties: Manufacturer identity, serial/lot, importer if any
marketSurveillanceDuties: Recall and corrective action as manufacturer
releaseRestrictions: All hardware gates closed before any offer

scenarios.title: Imported white-label hardware
scenarios.description: A third-country supplier manufactures a device; EMBARCARTE imports and may rebrand it.
scenarios.supplierModel: OEM/white-label agreement; supplier remains legal manufacturer.
obligations: Verify supplier conformity and CE evidence
Do not treat supplier certificate as certification of rebranded product
marketSurveillanceDuties: Verify and act; inform supplier and authority
scenarios.warrantyLiability: Importer joint responsibility; recourse against supplier.
releaseRestrictions: No import or offer before supplier evidence verification

scenarios.title: Third-party certified receiver module
scenarios.description: MAREA integrates a certified AIS/GNSS module into a receiver product.
scenarios.supplierModel: Module supplier holds radio/EMC certificates for the module only.
obligations: Assess the integrated product as a whole
New DoC for the final product
Do not pass through module certificate as product certificate
contractsNeeded: Module supply agreement with conformity representations
traceabilityDuties: Module batch to final serial linkage
marketSurveillanceDuties: Manufacturer duties for the integrated product
releaseRestrictions: Module certificate alone never satisfies the gate

scenarios.title: Raspberry Pi-based integrated appliance
scenarios.description: A single-board computer runs the navigation appliance with third-party software and open-source components.
scenarios.supplierModel: SBC/compute module supplier; EMBARCARTE integrates hardware and software.
obligations: CRA secure development and update lifecycle
scenarios.warrantyLiability: Manufacturer of the appliance; component warranties flow through.
releaseRestrictions: GPL/source-provision and CRA gates must close

scenarios.title: Pico-based embedded controller
scenarios.description: A microcontroller board controls motors or sensors as part of PILOT/SENSE.
scenarios.supplierModel: MCU board plus EMBARCARTE firmware and enclosure.
releaseRestrictions: PILOT remains unsellable regardless of controller readiness

scenarios.title: Installer-supplied system
scenarios.description: A professional installer specifies, supplies and commissions a MAREA-based system for a vessel owner.
scenarios.supplierModel: EMBARCARTE supplies products to the installer; the installer contracts with the owner.
scenarios.warrantyLiability: Installer for installation; EMBARCARTE for product; allocation in contract.
releaseRestrictions: No 'certified installer' claim until a scheme exists

scenarios.title: Hosted software service
scenarios.description: A cloud service delivers NAV/WEATHER features and subscriptions.
scenarios.supplierModel: Cloud and data providers under contract; EMBARCARTE operates the service.
releaseRestrictions: No SLA or certification claim before evidence

scenarios.title: Licensed marine-data service
scenarios.description: Charts, weather, bathymetry or tiles are licensed and re-displayed in a paid offering.
scenarios.supplierModel: Data providers grant display/cache/offline rights under written licence.
marketSurveillanceDuties: Remove data if rights lapse; correct provenance
scenarios.warrantyLiability: Contractual liability to provider and customer; reliance disclaimers do not remove statutory liability.
releaseRestrictions: No data feature before GATE-DATA-LICENSING

scenarios.title: Fleet SaaS
scenarios.description: A multi-tenant B2B service monitors vessels and shares telemetry within a fleet organisation.
scenarios.supplierModel: FLEET operator is the customer/controller; EMBARCARTE hosts and processes.
traceabilityDuties: Tenant, vessel, user and audit logs
scenarios.warrantyLiability: B2B contractual liability; processor liability under GDPR.
releaseRestrictions: No FLEET sale before privacy, security and B2B gates close
